verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document free trials, trial-to-paid auto-conversion, coupon or promotion-code objects, or trial-end notifications. The only nearby items are per-subscription discount edits and monthly free-token allowances. Those are adjacent pricing features, not a trial, coupon or promo-code lifecycle, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can run free trials, coupons, and promotion codes with automatic conversion to paid — including trial-end notifications required by card-network rules
